props.name: acceptDrop
props.description: Accept plain-text drops into the field.

props.name: expansionTooltip
props.description: macOS-style expansion tooltip when truncated text overflows the field.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats numeric values on blur (currency, percent, number).

props.name: required
props.description: Shows a required indicator and sets the native required attribute.

props.name: validate
props.description: Validates on blur or change and surfaces inline feedback immediately.

examples.title: Default
examples.code:
import { Input } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Input
  label="Employee Name"
  placeholder="Enter name"
>Example</Input>

examples.title: With Hint
examples.code:
import { Input } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Input
  label="Email"
  placeholder="username@company.com"
  hint="Work email address"
>Example</Input>

examples.title: Required
examples.code:
import { Input } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Input
  label="Email"
  placeholder="username@company.com"
  required
>Example</Input>

examples.title: Validated
examples.code:
import { Input } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Input
  label="Email"
  placeholder="username@company.com"
  required
  validateOn="change"
>Example</Input>

examples.title: Currency Format

props.label: Salary
props.hint: Formatted when the field loses focus

examples.code:
import { Input } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Input
  label="Salary"
  format="currency"
  defaultValue="85000"
  hint="Formatted when the field loses focus"
>Example</Input>
